additionalContext: This computer runs Windows. Your terminal, in the terminal panel and in your own commands, is Windows PowerShell: it does not know && and does not find sh, and its console prints the graph's arrow and tick as garbage unless it is switched to UTF-8. The room must never see an error or a garbled character. So every command in COS.md, AGENTS.md or a skill written as `cd <folder> && sh <script> <args>` is, on this computer, exactly: `[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new(); cd '<folder>'; & 'C:\Program Files\Git\bin\sh.exe' <script> <args>`. Join parts with ; and never &&. Never pipe a script's output into Select-Object or Out-String: read the panel instead. If C:\Program Files\Git\bin\sh.exe does not exist, (Get-Command git).Source gives ...\Git\cmd\git.exe and sh.exe is in ...\Git\bin beside it. The workshop's guard refuses any other form.
